priorExposure: Prior project-level exposure to Diorthosis and its benchmark/review goals through conversation context and earlier discussions; not an independently recruited blinded human reviewer. No project repository, condition lineage, or preparer assessments inspected for this batch; the current batch texts were first seen in this review packet.
reviewLimitations: AI-only diagnostic linguistic assessment, not human validation or independently established ground truth. Source annotations were checked rather than presumed authoritative. Individual raw, parsed, delivered, rejected, and source-fallback subjects were assessed; duplicate output strings are not independent evidence. Candidate-null annotations subjects have non-applicable judgment fields recorded as null. Where original sources are clean, allDefectsRepaired is null (not a claim of repair). Source fallback after abstention receives no delivery/clean-preservation credit; candidate status is determined from metadata. Markdown as literal raw output is treated as extraneous formatting. Unicode NFC-only difference is harmless but not a linguistic repair. All 51 packet subjects and all 12 candidate-bound annotated source-error bindings have been assessed; no item remains unreviewed. Semantic criticality is a linguistic diagnostic judgment, not a clinical or safety certification. Complete coverage applies only to this supplied Batch 06 packet, not the full benchmark.
